description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {3} tageting any two applicable permanents.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting any two applicable permanents.
Holding priority, activate Errant by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Ghostly Flicker copy targeting Errant and Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the first copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Errant and Chromattic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4.
